before-jungle-potion.npc: Greetings Bwana! I am Trufitus Shakaya of the Tai Bwo Wannai village.

steps.npc: It means friend, and friends come in peace. I assume that you come in peace?
Well, that is good news, as I may have a proposition for you.
I hoped you would think so. My people are afraid to stay in the village.
They have returned to the jungle and I need to commune with the gods
to see what fate befalls us. You can help me by collecting some herbs that I need.
I need to make a special brew! A potion that helps me to commune with the gods. For this potion, I need very special herbs, that are only found in the deep jungle.
I can only guide you so far as the herbs are not easy to find. With some luck, you will find each herb in turn and bring to me. I will give you details of where to find the next herb.
In return for this great favour I will give you training in Herblore.

steps.player: It sounds like just the challenge for me. And it would make a nice break from killing things!

steps.npc: That is excellent Bwana! The first herb that you need to gather is called
Snake Weed.
It grows near the vines in an area to the south west where
the ground turns soft and the water kisses your feet.

steps.player: Hmmm, sounds difficult, I don't know if I am ready for the challenge.

steps.npc: Very well then Bwana, maybe you will return to me invigorated and ready to take up the challenge one day?

options.text: I am very sorry, but I don't have time for that.

steps.player: I am very sorry, but I don't have any time for that.

steps.npc: Very well then, may your journeys bring you much joy.
Maybe you will pass this way again and you then take up my proposal?
But for now, fare thee well.

options.text: I am sorry, but I am very busy.

steps.player: I am sorry, but I am very busy.

steps.npc: Very well then, may your journeys bring you much joy.
Maybe you will pass this way again and you then take up my proposal?
But for now, fare thee well.

options.text: What does a warrior like me know about peace?

steps.player: What does a warrior like me know about peace?

steps.npc: When you grow weary of violence and seek a more enlightened path, please pay me a visit
as I may have a proposition for you. Now I need to attend to the plight of my people. Please excuse me...

options.text: Tai Bwo Wannai? What does that mean?

steps.player: Tai Bwo Wannai? What does that mean?

steps.npc: It means 'small clearing in the jungle' but it is now the name of our village.

options.text: It's a nice village, where is everyone?

steps.player: It's a nice village, where is everyone?

steps.npc: My people are afraid to stay in the village. They have returned to the jungle. I need to commune with the gods to see what fate befalls us.
You may be able to help with this.

options.text: I am sorry, but I am very busy.
I am sorry, but I am very busy.
It's a nice village, where is everyone?

after-jungle-potion.npc: My greatest respects Bwana, I have communed with my gods and the future
looks good for my people. We are happy now that the gods are not angry with us.
With some blessings we will be safe here.
You should deliver the good news to Bwana Timfraku, Chief of Tai Bwo Wannai. He lives in a raised hut not far from here.

selling-herbs-grimy-herb.npc: Sorry, Bwana, that herb is so dirty that I can't even tell whether it is fresh. Please clean it first.

selling-herbs-clean-herb.npc: Many thanks for the herb Bwana. I'll add it to my collection.

selling-herbs-clean-herb.text: Trufitus gives you [a coin/2 coins/3 coins/4 coins] for the [snake weed/ardrigal/sito foil/volencia moss/Rogue's Purse].

after-completing-shilo-village.text: When spoken to for the first time:

steps.npc: Hello Bwana. I conclude that you have been successful. Mosol sent word that the village is clearing of zombies. You have done us all a great deed!
Why not go and visit him and have a look around Shilo village. You may find some interesting things there!
Hello again Bwana! Well Done again for helping to defeat Rashiliyia. Hopefully things will return to normal around here now.
Greetings!
I hope things are going well for you now. I have no new information since last we spoke. Needless to say, that if something does come up I will certainly get in touch directly.
